lines.zh: 脚步声声，铁片摩擦作响。
lines.en: Clank clank, iron plates scrape.
Heavy steps, like iron plates walking.

lines.zh: 挥刀前行，铁刃划过地面。
lines.en: Swing the sword, iron blade scratches the ground.

lines.zh: 刀鞘轻轻摩擦，随步声响起。
lines.en: Scrape of the scabbard, with the footsteps.

lines.zh: 铁甲少年，脚步踏出坚毅。
lines.en: Iron youth, steps show determination.
Ground marks from iron plates.

lines.zh: 步伐稳健，踏出刀锋的影子。
lines.en: Solid steps, shadow of the blade.

lines.zh: 铁甲摩擦，脚步声渐行渐远。
lines.en: Iron scrape, footsteps fade away.

lines.zh: 刀刃与地面摩擦，发出低沉声响。
lines.en: Sword scrapes ground, low rumble.

lines.zh: 铁甲的响动，回荡在空旷的环境中。
lines.en: Iron clank echoes in the empty area.
I jog along hugging a whetstone.
My wooden sandals click on the stone path.

lines.zh: 静默中，铁甲闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: Silent, iron plates shine.
Iron youth, silent thoughts.

lines.zh: 铁甲微颤，仿佛有力量在积蓄。
lines.en: Iron plates tremble, power building.

lines.zh: 持刀站立，铁甲少年目光坚定。
lines.en: Holding sword, firm eyes.

lines.zh: 铁甲少年，手中刀刃闪烁。
lines.en: Iron youth, sword glinting in hand.

lines.zh: 铁甲映照着天光，闪烁着金属的光泽。
lines.en: Iron plates shine under sunlight.

lines.zh: 铁甲少年，一言不发，凝视远方。
lines.en: Iron youth, silent, gazing afar.

lines.zh: 铁甲微动，仿佛随时准备战斗。
lines.en: Iron plates move, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 手持刀剑，铁甲少年静静站立。
lines.en: Holding sword, iron youth stands still.

lines.zh: 铁甲少年，沉默中积蓄力量。
lines.en: Iron youth, silent, gathering strength.
Sword glinting, looking at player.
Iron youth, staring at player.
I hold the whetstone tighter.
Iron youth, grave gaze.

lines.zh: 刀鞘微颤，铁甲少年目光锐利。
lines.en: Scabbard trembling, sharp eyes.
Iron youth, gaze like a torch.
Sword trembling, looking at player.
Iron youth, icy gaze.
Iron youth, sharp gaze.

lines.zh: 刀尖指向玩家，铁甲少年目光如炬。
lines.en: Sword pointing at player, gaze like a torch.

lines.zh: 小铁身体一震，他太脆弱了。
lines.en: Kotetsu shudders; he's too frail.

lines.zh: 这小子受伤了，需要休息。
lines.en: The little guy's injured, needs rest.
Kotetsu's arm is bleeding.
Kotetsu's armor is cracked.
Kotetsu's blade is damaged.
Kotetsu's ankle is hurt.
Kotetsu's hit by a collision.
Kotetsu's back is injured.
Kotetsu's hands hurt.
Kotetsu's stomach hurts.

lines.zh: 听你说话，我肚子里的铁块在响！
lines.en: Hearing you talk, my stomach's iron clanks.
Don't go, give me some food!

lines.zh: 我的刀刃空着呢，来吃点东西吧！
lines.en: My blade's empty, come eat something.

lines.zh: 铁匠铺里有我的家，你跟我回去吧！
lines.en: I have a home in the smithy, go with me!

lines.zh: 村里的食物不多了，跟我走吧！
lines.en: Food's scarce in the village, come with me!
Come, let me give you some food!

lines.zh: 一起吃饭，我有你想要的！
lines.en: Eat together, I have what you want!

lines.zh: 跟我一起，你不会饿肚子！
lines.en: Eat with me, you won't go hungry!
Stewed meat, come try it!
Son of the smith, have some food!
Don't touch me, I'm hard!
Try bumping into me!
Iron bumps you, beware!
Hit me, your head will hurt!
You touch me, I'll retaliate!
Stay away, you'll get hurt!
I'm hard, don't touch me!
Try bumping me, I'm iron!
Don't touch me, I'm iron hard!
Don't move, I have hard armor!
Find a mate, forge iron together!

lines.zh: 跟我一起，炼出最好的铁！
lines.en: Come with me, forge the best iron!
Find a smith, be my mate!

lines.zh: 和我一起，我们能打造更强！
lines.en: With me, we can forge stronger!

lines.zh: 找一个铁匠，做我的伴侣！
lines.en: Find a smith, be my mate!
On the forge, find a partner!
Smith's child, be my companion!
Forge iron, find an iron mate!

lines.zh: 和我一起炼铁，你将成为我的伴侣！
lines.en: Forge iron with me, you'll be my mate!
I want a companion to guard the village with.
Pick up my fallen iron shavings.
My family’s heirloom sword.
Don’t underestimate this blade.
My father forged swords with it.
Feel the grip of this blade.
This is my protective item.

lines.zh: 它见证了我父亲的技艺。
lines.en: It bears witness to my father’s craft.
The blade needs your warmth.

lines.zh: 我曾用它锻造无数刀具。
lines.en: I forged countless blades with it.
This is the pride of a bladesmith.
Target acquired.
The villagers are not safe.
Do not let the blade idle.

lines.zh: 那边有把刀，是父亲打的。
lines.en: That blade over there was forged by my father.

lines.zh: 我的刀是唯一的守护者。
lines.en: My blade is the only guardian.
My blade can protect the village.
This is a gesture of respect to the blade.
The blade’s light shines.
This blade is the only hope.
This blade guards everything.
You may not touch this blade.

lines.zh: 你踩到锻刀村的地界了。
lines.en: You crossed into swordsmith village ground.

lines.zh: 这块石头上刻着刀匠的名字。
lines.en: A swordsmith's name is carved on this stone.
One more step and I shout for help.

lines.zh: 这里每块石头都有名字。
lines.en: Every stone here has a name.
I watch you from behind the sword rack.
I raise my blade, hands shaking.
The blade must act.
Target in sight.
Let the blade decide.
This blade is inviolate.
The blade’s will cannot be defied.

lines.zh: 刀刃的轨迹是唯一的路。
lines.en: The blade’s path is the only way.
This blade is the only path.
The blade’s edge cannot be ignored.
The blade’s will cannot be disobeyed.

lines.zh: 我握紧了这把没人要的刀。
lines.en: I grip this blade no one wanted.
My father's sweat is still on the hilt.
Stand back, I'm going to swing.
I've practiced this cut for three years.
Don't laugh; the blade is serious.
I'll prove it isn't junk.
My hands shake; the blade doesn't.

lines.zh: 我得替父亲挥出这一刀。
lines.en: I must swing this for my father.
You're standing just right.
The tip is on you; don't blame me.

lines.zh: 发出叮当声，挥舞小刀攻击！
lines.en: Clanging sounds, swinging the small knife!
Holding the small knife, charging at you!
Swinging the small knife, hissing loudly!

lines.zh: 用小刀攻击，发出微弱的响声！
lines.en: Attacking with the small knife, making a faint noise!
Screaming while swinging the small knife!
Lifting the small knife, ready to attack!
Swinging the small knife, making a light sound!
Screaming, swinging the small knife!

lines.zh: 挥舞着小刀，发出嘶嘶声！
lines.en: Swinging the small knife, hissing!

lines.zh: 举起小刀，嘶嘶叫着攻击！
lines.en: Raising the small knife, screaming and attacking!
I swing at your knees!
The flat of my blade smacks your leg!
I missed, but it still hurts!
I jab your side with the scabbard!
My iron guard hits your chin!
My edge opens your sleeve!
I struck your armor!
The blade is dull, but heavy!
I shout and swing wildly!
Stop dodging, I aimed!

lines.zh: 从刀石中跃出，冲向猎物！
lines.en: Jumping out of the swordstone, charging at the prey!

lines.zh: 从刀石中弹出，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Bouncing out of the swordstone, searching for prey!

lines.zh: 从刀石中跳出，挥舞小刀！
lines.en: Jumping out of the swordstone, swinging the small knife!

lines.zh: 从刀石中跳出，准备攻击！
lines.en: Jumping out of the swordstone, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 从刀石中跃出，寻找食物！
lines.en: Jumping out of the swordstone, searching for food!

lines.zh: 从刀石中跳出，嘶嘶叫着！
lines.en: Jumping out of the swordstone, hissing!

lines.zh: 从刀石中跃出，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Jumping out of the swordstone, charging at the prey!

lines.zh: 从刀石中跃出，挥舞小刀！
lines.en: Jumping out of the swordstone, swinging the small knife!

lines.zh: 我抱着刀从村里跑出来。
lines.en: I run out of the village with a blade.
The sharpening stopped; I'm here.

lines.zh: 锻刀村的少年站在路口。
lines.en: A boy from the swordsmith village stands at the crossing.

lines.zh: 我背着一把半成品的刀。
lines.en: I carry a half-finished blade.
Kotetsu was burned by fire.
Kotetsu fell from a height.
Kotetsu was drowned.
Kotetsu was shaken by an explosion.
Kotetsu was shot by an arrow.
Kotetsu was hit by magic.
Kotetsu is starved and weak.
Kotetsu was struck by lightning.
Kotetsu fell into the void.
